field.label: Aggregate retention (days)
field.help: Number of daily WhoisDS archives to retain and include in the published aggregate. Range: 1–15 days. Default: 3.

field.label: Exclude TLDs / suffixes
field.help: Comma-separated suffixes to omit from the aggregate. Example: ru,cn,xyz. You may also enter multi-label suffixes such as co.uk. Daily source archives remain unmodified.
